BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 21 Killala Road to the Cabra property market.

From the moment you arrive, it is clear this charming home has been thoughtfully enhanced. The front garden has been converted into a private driveway, providing the highly desirable benefit of off-street parking.

Internally, the property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout. A welcoming entrance hallway leads to a spacious living room positioned to the front of the home, while to the rear is a generous open-plan living and dining area, creating an ideal space for both everyday family life and entertaining guests.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises two spacious double bedrooms and a well-appointed family bathroom.

One of the property’s standout features is the exceptionally large rear garden, offering excellent potential to extend the existing accommodation (subject to the necessary planning permission) while still retaining substantial outdoor space for relaxation, gardening, or family enjoyment.

Situated in one of Cabra’s most established and sought-after residential locations, Killala Road enjoys an enviable position within walking distance of Stoneybatter, Phibsborough, Smithfield, and Dublin’s north city centre, while also benefiting from excellent cycling connections across the city.

The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, including the LUAS Cross City line and numerous Dublin Bus routes. A proposed new train station as part of the nearby Hamilton Gardens development on Carnlough Road is expected to further enhance connectivity. The property also enjoys convenient access to the N3, M50 motorway, Blanchardstown, and Dublin Airport via the Navan Road.

Residents benefit from an excellent selection of local amenities, including shops and a crèche within the nearby Hamilton Gardens development, just a five-minute walk away. A wider range of cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, and leisure facilities can be found along Cabra Road and in the vibrant villages of Phibsborough and Stoneybatter, while the TU Dublin Grangegorman campus is also within easy reach.

Combining generous living accommodation, exceptional outdoor space, off-street parking, and an outstanding location, 21 Killala Road represents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, growing families, and investors alike.

Early viewing is highly recommended.

Disclaimer: While every effort has been made to ensure the accuracy of this information, some details may have been provided by the vendor. Prospective purchasers are advised to satisfy themselves as to the correctness of all particulars through independent inspection.
